Chuồn Chuồn Bistro & Bar – The Perfect Sunset Spot in Phu Quoc
Mar 2025 • Couples
Perched on a hill, Chuồn Chuồn Bistro & Bar offers one of the most stunning sunset views in Phu Quoc. The open-air setting, cozy ambiance, and panoramic scenery make it a must-visit spot for anyone looking to unwind.

The menu features a delightful mix of Vietnamese and Western dishes, all made with fresh ingredients and beautifully presented. Their cocktails are top-notch, perfect for sipping as you watch the sun dip below the horizon. The staff is friendly and attentive, ensuring a wonderful experience from start to finish.

Whether you're here for a morning coffee, a sunset drink, or a romantic dinner, Chuồn Chuồn Bistro & Bar never disappoints. A truly magical spot that I highly recommend!
